In addition, three unhistoriated ornamented medium initials are found on f. 26va5-10, f. 32va22-25 and f. 38rb1-5. Finally, on ff. 140-141, historiated scenes accompany the featured calendarium in the lower margins (Hunting with falcon for May, pulling weeds for June, ploughing for July, harvesting grain for August, harvesting fruits for Septemb er, sowing for Octover, butchering for November and brewing for December). Many of the minor and remaining medium initials are inhabited and feature human heads likely connected in one way or another to the introduced text sections.
